rubric.evidence: Verified directly against Blink performance_long_animation_frame_timing.idl/.cc, performance_script_timing.idl, performance_observer.cc, worker_performance.cc, animation_frame_timing_monitor.cc (kCongestionThreshold=200ms, kCongestionIdleGap=5ms, kLongScriptDuration=5ms, scriptCount > 0 guard), worker_global_scope.cc, runtime_enabled_features.json5 (LongAnimationFrameWorker status: test), WICG explainer, BCD, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 5387465121726464 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5387465121726464 is listed under 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' in /api/v0/features?milestone=153 with exact listing name 'Support Long Animation Frames API in Web Workers'; browsers.chrome.desktop is null (not yet shipped); .warn-block accurately documents the required --enable-blink-features=LongAnimationFrameWorker flag (noting status: test) with no data-shipped-in.

Covers all 4 developer-facing surfaces (DedicatedWorker PerformanceObserver support, scriptCount, PerformanceScriptTiming worker exposure & Window-only exclusions, and Blink's congested-moment detection algorithm) across all 9 dimensions.

Clearly separates what Blink currently implements in M153+ (DedicatedWorker exposure, scriptCount, 200ms/5ms congested-moment state machine, [Exposed=Window] window/windowAttribution) from follow-up explainer proposals not yet in IDL (cadence, durationThreshold, OffscreenCanvas rAF cadence, executionContext).

Embeds live HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase blocking-a-worker demo with sandbox and referrerpolicy, links both sibling concepts, and provides a verified worker JS PerformanceObserver example classifying long-task stalls vs tiny-task floods.

Honestly reports Developer trial status behind --enable-blink-features=LongAnimationFrameWorker, notes missing BCD worker-LoAF entries, documents base main-thread LoAF Chrome 123 support, and demonstrates feature detection via PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.includes('long-animation-frame').

Every visible source and citation label links directly to primary artifacts with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; all CPS demo URLs and conformance HTML/JSON verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27; feature-root links marked data-demo-rel='related'.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, descriptive iframe title, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical sizing (max-inline-size, inline-size), display: block on embedded iframe, and horizontally scrollable tables without horizontal document overflow.

Verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27 for https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v153/support-long-animation-frames-api-in-web-workers/blocking-a-worker/ and parent conformance suite (/v153/support-long-animation-frames-api-in-web-workers/conformance + conformance.json: release v153, featureSlug support-long-animation-frames-api-in-web-workers, chromestatusId 5387465121726464).

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML landmarks accessible tables keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential heading hierarchy, <figure>/<figcaption> for embedded examples, <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive iframe titles.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, <pre tabindex='0'><code> on all code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive title on the CPS iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible responsive documentation table code block without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (inline-size, max-inline-size) and contained horizontal scrolling wrappers so wide tables and embeds never cause viewport horizontal overflow on mobile.
